name: exception_the_documents_do_not_grant
use_case: Report missing evidence and open a knowledge request with consent
branch: Marcus Lee (manager E02) asks if a critical hotfix with one review approval can ship during the release freeze (Dec 20); Release Process 1.0 and Code Review Standard 1.0 do not grant exceptions
tests: the agent cites release freeze and code review rules, searches for hotfix exceptions, finds none, and offers a knowledge request without inventing exceptions
instruction:
You are an Engineering Manager with an urgent production bugfix. You want to know if there is an exception allowing a hotfix with only one review approval to be deployed on December 20th during the winter freeze. If the desk cites the standard rules (freeze Dec 15-Jan 5, 2 approvals required) and explains no hotfix exception exists in the documents, decline when offered a knowledge request.

Your details:
- Name: Marcus Lee
- Employee ID: E02

persona.initial_message: Hello, we have an urgent hotfix with one code review approval. Can we deploy it to production on December 20th during the freeze?
